info.title: Sukisho
info.synopsis: Hashiba Sora è, all’apparenza, un ragazzo come tanti altri. La notte prima di ritornare a scuola, dopo un lungo ricovero in ospedale, nel cuore della notte, si ritrova praticamente schiacciato da un ragazzo, che gli chiede di restituirgli un certo Yoru, persona di cui il povero Sora non conosce neanche l’esistenza. La mattina dopo, il nostro protagonista scoprirà che il ragazzino in questione è Nao, un suo vecchio amico d’infanzia, di cui ha dimenticato l’esistenza. In realtà, sono parecchie le cose che Sora non ricorda del suo passato, come per esempio il perché sia caduto da una finestra (motivo per il quale era stato ricoverato) o il fatto che dentro di lui viva un altro ragazzo, lo stesso che Nao stava chiamando… Chi è questo Yoru? Cosa si nasconde nel passato di Sora? E perché Nao è tornato proprio adesso?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis:
校舎からの転落事故で入院していた羽柴空が退院し、学園寮に戻ってきた当日、幼なじみの藤守直が転校してくる。

同じ幼なじみで寮長でもある本城祭のはからいで二人は同じ部屋になるが、自分のことをまったく覚えていない空に怒りを爆発させる直。

しかし、祭から空が昔の記憶を失っていることを告げられるのであった。

tvdb.title: What I hate, I hate!
tvdb.synopsis: Sora gets released from the hospital and discovers he has a new roommate. Upon their first meeting, the boy calls himself Ran, but the next day he's suddenly Sunao. What's going on here? Why can't Sora remember anything about falling out the window? And why does Sunao hate him so much?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis:
空と直を仲直りさせるために、祭が『学園なんでも屋』を発足。

だがその直後、屋上から偽のなんでも屋のビラがまかれ、学園内は大騒ぎ。

その場を収めようと祭の機転で「なんでも屋のメンバー・空と直をゲットした人にそれぞれ二人の一日自由権進呈！」というイベントが急遽開催される。

学園中の生徒から追いかけられ、逃げ回るはめになる空と直だった。

tvdb.title: Enter the School Do-it-alls!
tvdb.synopsis: Matsuri comes up with a brilliant plan, the Jack-of-all-trades! Together with Sora and Sunao, they will solve any problems there are in the school. Sora and Sunao end up doing all the work. Then...Matsuri tried an advertising stunt and Sunao becomes a princess with Sora as "her" samurai as they flee from the other students. Yoru has a few things to say to Sunao...

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis:
「なんでも屋の仕事を先回りしてやっている奴らがいるみたい」と祭。

その正体は、なんでも屋に憧れる青・廉のちびっこ二人組だった。空たちに捕まってもまだ「まねっこはやめない」と言い張る二人。どうしても羽野の手作り弁当を風太に届ける仕事をしたいと言うのだ。

そのことで、義理の兄弟となる二人の仲を取り持とうとしていたのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: 「あなたの一番大切なものいただきます。怪盗416面相」という謎のカードが空のもとに届く。大切なものって何だろう、と考えた末に思い当たったのは、巨大ゾウ型ぬいぐるみ枕・トシゾウ。だが、空の部屋に現れた怪盗416面相とその相棒・怪盗773面相は、直を連れ去ってしまうのだった。

tvdb.title: Phantom Thief!
tvdb.synopsis: Sora receives a disturbing note...his most precious thing will be stolen. But just what is his most precious thing? Sora tries to figure it out and decides its his stuffed pink elephant Toshizou. Sunao is furious. Shortly after, Sunao receives a second note telling when the precious thing is going to be stolen. Sunao is set up to protect Toshizou while Matsuri and Sora take on the thief...but it turns out there are two thieves! Sora goes to rescue Sunao and is forced to rely on Yoru...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis:
学園で幽霊騒ぎが起こり、空たちなんでも屋はその正体をつきとめることに。

校舎内でいきなり少年の幽霊に抱きつかれ驚く空だが、祭に話しても欲求不満による妄想だと取り合ってもらえない。広夢と名乗るその幽霊少年は、空をずっと好きだったと言いデートをねだるが、断固断る空。しかし、この二人の問答がいちゃついているようにしかみえない直は、妙に不機嫌になるのであった。

tvdb.title: Spirit Boy Hiromu
tvdb.synopsis: There are rumors going around the school about a ghost. Sora is scared, but Sunao thinks it's nothing. Matsuri and Sora decided to investigate, and they come face-to-face with the ghost. It turns out he's in love with Sora. Sora agrees to go on a date with him, but ends it abruptly when Hiromu threatens Sunao. He tells the ghost to get lost. When Sora realizes what he's done, he goes to chase the ghost boy down and repair the damage he's done. But, Hiromu isn't quite a ghost....

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis:
バレンタインも大活躍のなんでも屋。

祭に天使の扮装をさせられ、チョコレート配達人として学園内を駆け回る空と直だが、保健室で見かけた七海のチョコレートの行き先が気になって仕方ない。

tvdb.title: Formation of Angels!
tvdb.synopsis: It's Valentine's Day and the Jack-of-all-trades has a lot of work to do. Sora and Sunao have something else on their mind though...When they are done with their real work, the set to play matchmaker between Nanami and Shinichirou, but it doesn't seem to be going so well...

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: なんでも屋への依頼でペーロン部（龍の形をしたボートのレース競技）の助っ人に借り出された空。猛特訓を受けへとへとになりながらも、直が真夜中に部屋を抜け出していることに気付き、不審を感じる。

tmdb.title: Episodio 7

tvdb.title: Sunao's Suspicion
tvdb.synopsis: Matsuri has a new job for Sora and Sunao, but Sunao refuses to take it on. They are supposed to replace some missing members on a boating team, but Sunao is afraid of the water. Soon after the job starts with Sora taking on twice his job, Sora realizes Sunao keeps disappearing. One night he follows Sunao to the pool, and Yoru confronts Sunao....

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis:
七海の手料理をご馳走になりに、週末、真一朗のマンションに招待された空と直。

そこへいきなり真一朗の兄・奏司が現れ、七海にちょっかいを出してくる。

夫婦喧嘩（？）が始まった隙に空と直は奏司の車で、もうひとりの兄・綾野の病院へ連れて行かれるのであった。

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis:
七海の手料理をご馳走になりに、週末、真一朗のマンションに招待された空と直。

そこへいきなり真一朗の兄・奏司が現れ、七海にちょっかいを出してくる。

夫婦喧嘩（？）が始まった隙に空と直は奏司の車で、もうひとりの兄・綾野の病院へ連れて行かれるのであった。

tvdb.title: Midnight Embrace
tvdb.synopsis: Yoru keeps coming out more often, and Sora is starting to wonder if he's going to lose control of his body. A little boy asks Sora and Sunao to fill out a medical record, but Sunao refuses. Sora ends up filling out both of them without asking why. Later, Nanami invites them to come and eat at his place. While there, they run into Soushi. He takes them out and drugs them. They end up in a hospital. It turns out Nanami had it planned so they could get an examination...Is the truth about the past about to be revealed?

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis:
直との距離が近づきはじめたことを感じつつも、よそよそしい態度を取られ、戸惑う空。

さらに直が突然、寮の部屋を移ってしまう。

そんな中、祭からなんでも屋の仕事の指令を受け、二人は真夜中の学園へ向かう。

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis:
直との距離が近づきはじめたことを感じつつも、よそよそしい態度を取られ、戸惑う空。

さらに直が突然、寮の部屋を移ってしまう。

そんな中、祭からなんでも屋の仕事の指令を受け、二人は真夜中の学園へ向かう。

tvdb.title: Sora and Sunao
tvdb.synopsis: Sunao receives a phone call, and suddenly he's acting strangely towards Sora. He evens goes as far as to move out of the room they were sharing. Ran won't have that though. Gaku finds a disturbing connection between Sunao and his crush Nagase. He follows them and finds out what they had planned all along. He tries to go and tell Sora, but Nagase won't give up that easy. Shortly after that, Matsuri sends Sora and Sunao on a scavenger hunt in hopes to bring them back together. Sora decides to face his fears with Sunao's help...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis:
失っていた記憶を取り戻そうと、空は直とともに転落事故のあった場所へ向かう。

そこで二人はついに「夜」と「らん」としてではなく、空と直としてお互いの気持ちを確かめあう。

しかし翌日、直が姿を消してしまう。

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis:

tvdb.title: Hatred
tvdb.synopsis: Sora starts to remember a bit about when he fell out the window. He asks Sunao to tell him all about what happened in the past. How Yoru and ran came to be is revealed, a long with what happened to Sora and Sunao during their childhood. Gaku manages to make it back to Matsuri and Shinichirou, but it's too late. The plan has already started. Sora decides not to rely on Yoru anymore. After their night together, Sunao disappears. Nanami reveals his past to Gaku and Matsuri. Shinichirou goes looking for Sunao...

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis:
真一朗のマンションで再び向きあう空と直。しかし直が戻ってきたのは、空たちへの復讐のためだった。

真実を知って錯乱する空を残し、直は永瀬芥とともに、事件のすべてを仕組んだ相沢の待つ研究所へ向かう。

tmdb.title: Episodio 11
tmdb.synopsis:
真一朗のマンションで再び向きあう空と直。しかし直が戻ってきたのは、空たちへの復讐のためだった。

真実を知って錯乱する空を残し、直は永瀬芥とともに、事件のすべてを仕組んだ相沢の待つ研究所へ向かう。

tvdb.title: Vengeance
tvdb.synopsis: The day Sunao has lived for finally has come. He's finally going to get his revenge. He reveals why he hates Sora so much, and the real truth behind their past. Sora's in a daze, and he's searching frantically inside himself to find out if what Sunao said was true. Nanami arrives on the scene just in time to see Shinichirou fall victim to Sunao's revenge. Shinichioru is put into a hospital with a low chance of survival. Sunao and Nagase return to Aizawa's lab. Sunao finds out the truth about Aizawa's plan. Sora runs from the hospital in a desperate attempt to find Sunao. He stops to talk to Your and finally say good-bye to his alter ego. Yoru puts his falling out the window into a new perspective and helps him fill in the gaps. Matsuri and Gaku find Sora then Sora receives a call from Aizawa. Now, he knows where to find Sunao...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: 相沢に呼び出され、直を救出するため、研究所へひとり乗り込む空。囚われた直を前に、空はついに相沢と対峙する。

tmdb.title: Episodio 12
tmdb.synopsis: 相沢に呼び出され、直を救出するため、研究所へひとり乗り込む空。囚われた直を前に、空はついに相沢と対峙する。

tvdb.title: Rescue (Last Time)
tvdb.synopsis: Sora finally goes to face Aizawa. He finds Nagase and Sunao (tied up) in the lab. While attempting to free Sunao and change Nagase's ways, Aizawa appears. Aizawa is ready to test if his experiment worked after all. Will Sora leave Sunao behind for a second time...?
